mom.headline: Multi-Agency Workplace Safety and Health Taskforce (MAST) calls for greater vigilance amidst rise in work‑related traffic accidents this year
mom.teaser: The Multi ‑ Agency Workplace Safety and Health Taskforce (MAST) [1] has called on industry stakeholders, employers, workers and road users to strengthen vigilance on the roads and in navigation. This is amidst a rise in road traffic accidents in recent years [2] and work ‑ related traffic accidents (WRTAs) this year.
